newsitem.title: USA: BET Holdings, Hilton mull hotel/casino.
newsitem.headline: BET Holdings, Hilton mull hotel/casino.

text.p: BET Holdings Inc, parent company of Black Entertainment Television, and Hilton Hotels Corp said on Thursday they had formed a joint venture to look at developing a hotel/casino in Las Vegas.
The operation, to be called BET SoundStage Casino, will target the more than 2.2 million African-American tourists who visit Las Vegas each year, the companies said.
BET plans to provide entertainment and marketing expertise, while Hilton will manage the gambling activities and the other hotel and recreational operations.

"We believe that BET's brand, its experience in the entertainment business and ability to target the black consumer marketplace provide a unique opportunity for BET to become a significant player in this exciting industry," Robert Johnson, BET chief executive officer, said in a statement.
